answer: Bindings are kept in spiral, verified in ripple, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the comet check. A farm of 4048 identities would post 1575 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
